video.drv_stream_note: Plays from your Drive, a little at a time. Nothing is copied into this browser.
video.drv_kept_note: Kept in this browser so it plays without internet. Remove download frees the space. The video in your Drive isn’t touched.
video.drv_note: Plays from your Drive, a little at a time, with the transcript following along. Only the link is kept in your work.
video.drv_note2: Download it to play here with the transcript following along, or watch it in Drive’s player. Only the link is kept in your work, and the video stays in your Drive.
video.drv_dropped: Download removed. The video is still in your Drive.
video.drv_bad: This video wouldn’t play straight from Drive. Download it for offline, or watch it in Drive’s player.
video.drv_room: There isn’t room on this computer for this video ({size}). Watch it without downloading instead.
video.drv_gone: Drive says this video isn’t there for you now. It may have been moved to the bin, or picked with another Google account. Pick it again with Add, A video.
video.drv_signin: Sign in with Google to play this video, then press the button again.
video.drv_no: Drive won’t hand this video over right now. Watch it in Drive’s player instead.
video.drv_say: Pick a video in your Drive. It plays from Drive, or you can download it for offline. Only the link is kept in your work.
